DCREM.description: Design Consideration of Rebar at Equalized Members (DCREM). Fields are driven by SELECT_ALL: when true the entire model is auto-scanned and SELECTED_MEMBERS is ignored; when false SELECTED_MEMBERS maps each Node ID to the elements to be equalized. The URL key is the Node ID (NodeK).

SELECT_ALL.description: Select All. When true, all existing DCREM records are deleted and the whole model is auto-scanned to group compatible beams; SELECTED_MEMBERS is ignored. When false, SELECTED_MEMBERS must be provided.

SELECTED_MEMBERS.description: [SELECT_ALL=false] Selected Members. Object keyed by Node ID (string); each value lists the elements connected at that node to be equalized.

ELEM_LIST.description: Element list of exactly 2 element numbers connected at the node.
GET response only. Element list of the equalized members for this Node ID.
